title: Unsafe natural-language → SQL/graph gateway

patterns.message: LLM-generated SQL/graph query over a (likely privileged) connection — prompt-to-query injection + privilege amplification (CVE-2024-8309).

remediation: Use whitelisted stored procedures / parameterized templates; enforce row/column-level security at the DB; cap result-set size; never run generated SQL on a privileged account.
